validity.recommendation: check length: the sheet has 1285 km but a Ukrainian operator table lists Chelyabinsk-Petrovsk at 1220 km and gives 1285 km to the Dashava-Kiev-Bryansk-Moscow line
validity.researcher_notes: Read the Ukrainian gas transport operator table (vtg.com.ua, Wayback copy of June 2022, cited by the wiki for P0791 and P0793). In its rows, Chelyabinsk-Petrovsk is 1400 mm, 7.4 MPa, 1220 km, one string, Russia. The 1285 km figure on the sheet sits on the Dashava-Kiev-Bryansk-Moscow row of the same table. The pipeline exists and is working (polit74.ru, July 2023). Diameter 1420 mm on the sheet comes from polit74.ru; the table gives the nominal 1400 mm. The wiki citation for this row did not state length, so this is a lead for a later pass, not a change.
